title: Create a development Google OAuth client and dev backend for local Anthus One portal work
description: The production Anthus One Google client authorizes only https://one.anth.us (kanbus-73f7b2 review). Local portal work (npm run dev:portal at http://localhost:5421) needs a separate development Google OAuth client with Authorized JavaScript origins http://localhost:5421 and http://localhost, exported as ANTHUS_ONE_DEV_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. The deployed portal API verifies only the production client as audience, so end-to-end local sign-in also needs a development backend (or a fixture API) that registers the dev client under its own reviewed policy ID. Needs Ryan's Google console access and approval for any new persistent IAM or API resources.
